summaryTab.matchCommentary:
The Test match at St George's Park commenced with high tactical intensity as South Africa posted 309/9 (78.3 ov) in their opening innings. In response, Zimbabwe countered with 68/10 (30.2 ov), setting the stage for a compelling contest of tactical endurance.
